value.rationale: The four-point equianharmonic rational branch configuration is a distinguished natural arithmetic instance of generalized Fermat genus-ten curves. Computing its full L-function reveals two copies of a genuinely F4-simple ordinary surface next to supersingular elliptic isotypic factors, and settles every extension-field point count. This adds meaningful structure beyond the known genus/p-rank/a-number and general Jacobian quotient decomposition.
